discovery: posthoc outside original QPF001-QPF006 source registry; never increment the frozen original six-source denominator

paper.title: Pollinator abundance shapes sexual selection in an angiosperm
paper.source_population_design: 16 experimental pollinator-observation populations/sessions at three Bombus terrestris abundance levels; Brassica rapa; original authors already showed observational vs genetic mate discrepancies

original_public_data.metadata_rule: Fetch official Zenodo /api/records/21628183 metadata with matching DOI/record ID. Only use recorded file links from that record with matching checksum/size. No external/raw unverified mirrors.
original_public_data.original_raw_files_publication_policy: DO NOT redistribute any published source records, genotype/parentage ID, individual plant/flower measurements, author R scripts, or original downloadable files through this research repository.

source_only_gate.on_read: Only original metadata, row counts, headers, biological keys session+ID_full and simple key-overlap counts; never compute/print raw signed SR, pollen grain, visits, seed count, paternity assignments or source individual observations in source-only phase.
source_only_gate.exact_joint_grain: (experimental session, original focal plant ID) in within-individual phenotypes and flower-level pollen sheet; one to many flowers per plant. Male/female may be separate analytical rows but one biological plant.
source_only_gate.historical_prior_findings: Original paper already measured Bombus visitation/movement → observational mate access → paternity and seeds. New discovery cannot be that these are separate sexual-selection episodes.
source_only_gate.true_compatibility_limit: Stigma total pollen load is not direct identification of genetically compatible pollen or allele-specific donor contribution to a given stigma.
source_only_gate.observation_limitation: Pollen sampled from 2–3 collected stigmas per source plant and seed output from multiple fruits; same plant possible, not same individual pollen-bearing flower → mature fruit.
source_only_gate.site_limit: 16 experimental sessions are not 16 independent regions, landscapes, countries, natural urban/island fragmentation programmes.
source_only_gate.if_unavailable: SOURCE_ACCESS_STOP, not biological null; freeze results, document HTTP/status/digest and avoid any invented offspring or plant analysis.

next_outcome_test_if_verified.status: DO_NOT_RUN_OR_OPEN_SIGNED_OUTCOMES_UNTIL exact source keys, valid session/plant overlap and source column semantics locked in a subsequent frozen protocol-only commit
next_outcome_test_if_verified.target: One original focal plant as unit, held-out entire experimental session; predict total female seed output and realized paternal mate diversity using recorded visitor contact/observational mate number, adding same-plant stigma pollen.
next_outcome_test_if_verified.primary_lock_needed: Baseline and pollen-augmented original variables, fit/regularization, unit definition, sex role, 16 entire-session folds, treatment condition, missing-P handling and success gate must be committed prior to the first actual outcome fit.
next_outcome_test_if_verified.no_causal_claim: Even a positive heldout predictive increment would not identify causal pollen deposition, selection, genetic rescue, or island–urban common regimes.
